passages.note: Vote page shows Wicks voting Aye on final passage of a bill setting wages only for the fast-food sector, not the general wage floor.

passages.provision_quote: The hourly minimum wage for fast food restaurant employees shall be twenty dollars ($20) per hour, effective April 1, 2024.
passages.note: Operative provision sets a wage floor only for fast food restaurant employees, via an appointed council with discretionary, capped future increases, not the general state minimum wage the rungs address.

rows.reasoning: AB 1228 sets a minimum wage only for fast food restaurant employees through an appointed Fast Food Council, with future increases discretionary and capped at the lesser of 3.5% or CPI-W change; it does not establish the general state wage floor the rungs describe, so it is adjacent to the ladder's question rather than on it.
